name: analytics-plan
description: Draft a tracking plan (events, properties, funnels) for a feature.
body: Draft an analytics tracking plan for $ARGUMENTS using the `analytics-instrumentation`/`product-analytics` skills. Define events with consistent naming, typed properties, funnels and success metrics — and explicitly keep PII out of properties. Output a table the team can implement against.

name: funnel
description: Analyze a conversion funnel and find the biggest drop-off.
body: Analyze the funnel in $ARGUMENTS using the `conversion-optimization`/`product-analytics` skills. Identify the biggest drop-off step, form hypotheses about the friction, and propose prioritized experiments (with success metrics and guardrails). Base it on data, not guesses.

name: convert
description: Transcode/convert media with the right codec and settings.
body: Convert the media file in $ARGUMENTS using the `video-processing`/`audio-editing` skills. Detect ffmpeg, pick a codec/container/bitrate suited to the target, prefer stream-copy when possible, and preserve quality. Confirm before overwriting an existing target and report the result.

name: optimize
description: Optimize images/media assets for the web (size/format).
body: Optimize the assets in $ARGUMENTS using the `image-processing`/`digital-asset-management`/`web-performance` skills. Generate responsive sizes and modern formats (WebP/AVIF), strip sensitive metadata, and report before/after sizes. Do not overwrite originals without confirmation.

name: cdc
description: Design or review a change-data-capture pipeline.
body: Design or review a CDC pipeline for $ARGUMENTS using the `change-data-capture` skill. Ensure log-based capture, ordering, idempotent consumers, schema-change handling and backpressure protection on the source. Report the design and risks.

name: contract
description: Define or validate a data contract between producer and consumer.
body: Define or validate a data contract for $ARGUMENTS using the `data-contracts` skill. Capture the schema, freshness/quality SLAs and versioning, and wire an enforcement check (schema validation in CI) so breaking changes fail fast. Report the contract and how it's enforced.

name: webrtc-debug
body: Diagnose the WebRTC issue in $ARGUMENTS using the `webrtc` skill. Check signaling, ICE candidate gathering, STUN/TURN reachability, and media negotiation. Identify why connectivity/media fails (often missing TURN) and propose the fix.

name: budget
body: Define and check performance budgets for $ARGUMENTS using the `web-performance` skill. Set budgets for bundle size and Core Web Vitals, measure current values (lighthouse/bundle analyzer), and report which budgets pass/fail with the top offenders.

name: visual-diff
description: Run visual regression tests and review diffs.
body: Run visual regression for $ARGUMENTS using the `snapshot-testing`/`e2e-testing` skills (Playwright/Percy/Chromatic if present). Capture and compare screenshots, review real differences vs noise, and report which changes are intended vs regressions.

name: i18n-extract
description: Find hardcoded strings and prepare them for translation.
body: Scan $ARGUMENTS for hardcoded user-facing strings using the `i18n-l10n` skill. List strings that should be externalized to message catalogs, flag concatenation/pluralization issues, and propose keys. Report findings; don't rewrite without confirmation.

name: sitemap
description: Generate a sitemap/site structure for a static site.
body: Generate a sitemap and structure overview for $ARGUMENTS using the `static-site-generators`/`web-seo` skills. Enumerate routes/content, produce sitemap.xml, and flag orphan pages or broken internal links.

name: model
description: Design a headless CMS content model for a use case.
body: Design a headless CMS content model for $ARGUMENTS using the `cms-headless` skill. Define content types, fields, references and localization, with a draft/preview workflow. Avoid coupling the content shape to one UI. Output the model and rationale.
